metrics.name: Puzzle Completed
metrics.description: A puzzle was solved (reached the target word).

metrics.name: Daily Returned
metrics.description: Player returned for a subsequent daily puzzle.

metrics.name: Time To Solve (ms)
metrics.description: Milliseconds from puzzle start to solve.

metrics.name: Invalid Move
metrics.description: A submitted move was rejected (not a word / multi-letter change).

metrics.name: Puzzle Abandoned
metrics.description: Player left mid-puzzle after at least one move.

metrics.name: Practice Puzzle Started
metrics.description: A practice puzzle was successfully generated for the selected difficulty.

metrics.name: Practice Puzzle Generation (ms)
metrics.description: Milliseconds to generate a practice puzzle.

metrics.name: Practice Puzzle Generation Error
metrics.description: Practice puzzle generation threw an error.

metrics.name: Hint Button Used
metrics.description: Player clicked the Hint button (treatment path only).

metrics.name: Powered-by Footer Viewed
metrics.description: The Powered by LaunchDarkly footer was rendered (treatment path only).

metrics.name: Share Result Clipboard Error
metrics.description: Clipboard write failed when sharing a daily result.

metrics.name: New Background Color Viewed
metrics.description: The green-tinted dark background (#1c3028) was applied (treatment path only). Monitoring metric for release visibility.

metrics.name: VC Sandbox Tagline Test — Tagline Viewed
metrics.description: Fires once on page load for every user (control index 0 and treatment index 1). Compares tagline impression counts between the two variations. Monitoring metric for exposure verification.

metrics.name: VC Sandbox Tagline Test — Puzzle Completed
metrics.description: Reuses the global puzzle_completed event. Compares puzzle completion rate between the punchier tagline (index 1) and the original tagline (index 0). Primary conversion guardrail for the tagline A/B test.
